description: Creating a budget plan is an important part of managing the finances of a family. The budget should be based on the family's monthly income and outline all expenses and bills. First, list all monthly income sources, including salaries, bonuses, investments, and other sources. Then, list all expected expenses, such as bills, mortgage, rent, utilities, insurance premiums, healthcare, groceries, and entertainment. After that, identify "extra" expenses such as holidays, vacation, and other luxuries.
